posts.caption:
bro said he was using the express lane 😭

he read the sign, saw the word “express,” and apparently decided walking was no longer part of the checkout experience.

everyone else brought groceries. this man brought 100-metre sprint form, terrible timing, and a level of confidence that should probably be studied.

the cashier is trying to scan bananas while he is trying to qualify for the supermarket olympics. nobody wins when the self-checkout becomes a racetrack.

fictional AI-made scenario — no shoppers were overtaken near aisle twelve. #dearwink
